topic_label: Commitment to integrity and ethical values
control_description: Code of conduct; POL-05 acknowledgment at hire and yearly; sanctions under POL-01 4.8
evidence: Code of conduct; acknowledgment report for Title and Closing staff (97%); sanctions log

control_description: Audit committee and Title and Closing board of managers oversee the program; quarterly reporting; annual Qualified Individual report (16 CFR 314.4(i))
evidence: Audit committee minutes 2026-09-29; board of managers minutes 2026-09-29
gap: The 2025 annual report went only to the parent audit committee and omitted service providers and testing results; one board of managers meeting with security on the agenda
remediation: Full 314.4(i) report to the board of managers; minuted quarterly oversight meetings (POAM-016)

control_description: Qualified Individual designated by the CEO and the board of managers; President of Title and Closing oversees the Qualified Individual; reporting lines in POL-01
Background checks for Title and Closing and escrow staff; annual training; role-based wire fraud training for closers and payoff processors
evidence: HR checklist sample; learning system report; P07 AT-2 and AT-3 results
gap: Staff who change payee data outside the closing team get no role-based training; content not updated after the 2025-11 loss
remediation: Role-based training for every team that changes payee data (POAM-002)

control_description: Policies assign accountability; control owners named in the SSP; sanctions applied
evidence: POL-01; P02 control owners; sanctions log

control_description: Security information comes from the SIEM, vendor reports, the risk register, and the asset inventory
evidence: SIEM source list; inventory; P07 CM-8 and AU-2 results
gap: SaaS application events (payee changes, exports) are not collected; the SaaS inventory is incomplete
remediation: SaaS logs in the SIEM (POAM-005); inventory reconciliation (POAM-007)

topic_label: Internal communication of objectives and responsibilities
control_description: POL-01 to POL-05 and the standards published on the intranet; training; monthly security notes to Title and Closing staff
Wire fraud warnings to buyers and sellers at contract and in the portal; incident and notice commitments to clients; contact points for lenders
evidence: Portal notice; contract packet warning; lender agreements
gap: No written system description or service commitments for lender and homebuilder clients; client complaint and security contact process informal
remediation: Management system description and commitments for the Type 1 report

topic_label: Objectives specified to enable risk identification
control_description: Objectives for closing accuracy, funds integrity, confidentiality, and availability set in the BIA and the SSP
Annual written risk assessment with NIST SP 800-30 (16 CFR 314.4(b))
evidence: P01 register and report; P07 RA-3 fully satisfied

control_description: Fraud risk is the core of the risk assessment: BEC, payoff fraud, payee changes, seller impersonation, insider payee changes
Significant changes (new systems, acquisitions, new clients) trigger a risk review
gap: No defined trigger for acquisitions or new business arrangements; SaaS setting changes not assessed
remediation: Change trigger in POL-01 procedures; SaaS changes under change control (POAM-007, POAM-010)

control_description: Annual independent assessment (P07); MSSP monitoring; quarterly payee change sample tests (STD-05)
gap: Key funds controls were not tested regularly before 2026; first quarterly sample test due 2027-03-31
remediation: Quarterly STD-05 sample tests by internal audit (POAM-002)

control_description: POA&M reviewed monthly by the COO and quarterly by the audit committee and the board of managers

topic_label: Control activities selected to mitigate risk
control_description: Controls selected from the SP 800-53 Moderate baseline tailored for High integrity
General IT controls over identity, SaaS tenants, cloud, and endpoints
evidence: Cloud guardrails; benchmark scans; P07 CM-6 results
gap: No documented SaaS security baselines; server benchmark compliance 71%
remediation: STD-01 baselines and drift report (POAM-007)

topic_label: Control activities deployed through policies and procedures
control_description: Policies and standards deployed through procedures and system settings
gap: 8 of 11 standards still in draft
remediation: Issue standards on the P06 schedule

topic_label: Logical access security software, infrastructure, architecture
control_description: SSO with MFA through the identity provider; security keys for wire release staff and administrators; secrets in the key vault
evidence: Identity provider policies; P07 IA-2(1) fully satisfied, IA-2(2) and IA-5 results
gap: The shared identity and email tenant has about 310 contractor agents without MFA; 7 integration secrets in configuration files
remediation: Agent MFA (POAM-001); secrets vaulted (POAM-012)

control_description: Title and Closing staff accounts created from the HR system with manager approval
evidence: HR-driven provisioning; P07 AC-2 sample of new accounts

control_description: Role-based access in SYS-02 and the portal; quarterly SYS-02 access reviews
evidence: SYS-02 role reports; P07 AC-2, AC-6, PS-4 results
gap: 31 staff with unneeded SYS-02 export rights; 12 standing global administrators; transfers kept prior roles (one closer kept disbursement rights 47 days); bank platform users removed late
remediation: Least privilege and just-in-time administration (POAM-004); lifecycle fixes (POAM-003)

control_description: Badge control at headquarters, the title operations center, and closing rooms
gap: Network closets at 9 of 22 offices, including 3 with closing rooms, use key locks
remediation: Badge readers (POAM-017); offices with closing rooms first

control_description: Certified shredding and drive wiping
gap: 2 leased printers returned without wipe records; no retention schedule triggers disposal
remediation: Lease return procedure; STD-10 (POAM-013)

topic_label: Protection against threats from outside boundaries
control_description: Web application firewall, denial-of-service protection, firewalls, conditional access
evidence: P04 cloud control map; firewall rule reviews

topic_label: Restriction of data transmission and movement
control_description: Wire instructions only through the portal; TLS for all SaaS and portal traffic
gap: Email with Social Security or account numbers is encrypted only when the sender chooses
remediation: Automatic encryption rule (POAM-022)

topic_label: Prevention and detection of unauthorized or malicious software
control_description: EDR on all endpoints and servers with 24x7 MSSP response; users cannot install software
evidence: EDR console; P07 SI-4 test results

topic_label: Detection of configuration changes and vulnerabilities
control_description: Vulnerability scanning and cloud posture monitoring
gap: 6 of 40 critical findings past target; file server and SD-WAN edges outside internal scans; SaaS setting drift not detected
remediation: Scan scope and escalation (POAM-014); SaaS drift reports (POAM-007)

topic_label: Monitoring for anomalies and security events
control_description: MSSP monitors identity, email, cloud, firewall, and EDR events 24x7
evidence: SIEM use cases; P07 AU-2, AU-6, SI-4 results
gap: Payee changes and exports in SYS-02 are not monitored; 6 old external forwarding rules went undetected
remediation: SaaS log integration and alerts (POAM-005)

control_description: Events triaged by the MSSP and the security team; severity in POL-03
gap: The 37 stopped payee change attempts are kept in a spreadsheet, not evaluated as security events
remediation: Single incident log (POAM-009)

control_description: P08 BEC and ransomware runbooks; funds response team; notification matrix
gap: Runbooks approved but not exercised; FTC consumer counting method not built
remediation: Tabletops 2026-11-18 and 2027-02-10 (POAM-009); counting worksheet (POAM-020)

control_description: Cloud workload backups and restore; downtime procedures in the BIA
evidence: Portal restore test 2026-03; P07 CP-2, CP-4, CP-10 results
gap: No SYS-02 downtime procedure in the plan; integration service and data warehouse never restored; closing downtime drill not held
remediation: Contingency plan, restore tests, and drill (POAM-008)

control_description: Weekly change board for infrastructure changes
evidence: Change tickets; P07 CM-3 and SA-11 results
gap: Portal releases approved by email without security review; 3 shared developer credentials deploy to production; no code scanning
remediation: Secure development and pipeline controls (POAM-010)

control_description: BIA; cyber insurance with a funds transfer fraud sublimit; closing protection letters
gap: SaaS outage scenarios not covered by tested procedures
remediation: Downtime procedures (POAM-008)

topic_label: Vendor and business partner risk management
control_description: Service provider tiering, contract terms, and annual Tier 1 reviews (STD-03; Part B)
gap: 4 of 11 Tier 1 reviews outstanding; 24 of 42 contracts without security terms; intercompany agreement without security terms
remediation: Complete reviews and amendments (POAM-015, POAM-016)

control_description: Capacity of the portal managed service and SaaS platforms monitored; vendor capacity commitments
Write-once backups of cloud workloads in a separate account and region; vendor backups for SaaS
evidence: Backup reports (July 2026, 31 of 31 days); P07 CP-9
gap: No independent backup of email and SYS-01 data; SYS-02 relies on the vendor (RPO 1 hour against a BIA RPO of 15 minutes)
remediation: Independent SaaS backup (POAM-008); vendor terms at renewal

control_description: Annual portal restore test
gap: Recovery testing covers only the portal; no closing downtime drill
remediation: Quarterly restore tests and the 2027-01-21 drill (POAM-008)

topic_label: Identification and maintenance of confidential information
control_description: Four-level classification (POL-04); Restricted data inventories per system
gap: 22 of 85 vendor and SaaS entries lack a data class; scanned closing files on the file server open to broad staff access
remediation: Inventory classification (POAM-007); file server restriction (POAM-013)

control_description: Certified destruction when information is disposed of
gap: No retention schedule; customer information kept indefinitely (16 CFR 314.4(c)(6))
remediation: STD-10 retention schedule and first purge (POAM-013)

control_description: Processing objectives: disburse only per closing instructions and the settlement statement (Fla. Stat. 626.8473(4)); balance every file before funding
gap: Processing commitments to lender and homebuilder clients not documented in a system description
remediation: System description for the Type 1 report

control_description: Inputs: payoffs from lender portals or verified by callback; wire instructions only through the portal; payee additions need a callback and second approver
evidence: P07 AC-5 samples (40 of 40 trust wires satisfied)
gap: Edits to existing payee bank details are saved by one user (25 of 25 sampled)
remediation: Two-person rule for every payee edit (POAM-002)

control_description: Processing: disbursement ledger by file; dual approval on every trust wire; positive pay; daily three-way reconciliation
evidence: Daily reconciliations (20 of 20 sampled in P03); bank approval logs

control_description: Outputs: settlement statements and disbursement confirmations; wire instructions displayed in the portal
evidence: Settlement statement review; portal release records
gap: No check that wire instructions displayed in the portal match the SYS-02 ledger
remediation: Display integrity check (POAM-010)

control_description: Stored data: SYS-02 ledger audit trail; vendor backups; monthly reconciliation signed by the President of Title and Closing
